hero.headline: No borders. Only bridges.
hero.subhead: Kimere is young, flexible and distributed across multiple countries. We are a network of independent professionals, not an office with a reception desk. We built it this way on purpose, because the students and universities we support are not in a single place either. We started in June 2026 by betting on young talent, and we prefer to show you how we work right away rather than bore you with our history.

match.heading: The person answering your call comes from where you come from
match.body: Bureaucracy is only half of what makes moving abroad frightening. The other half is having to explain yourself in a language you are still learning, to someone who has never lived your exact experience. We do the most obvious thing that almost nobody does. If our team covers your country, a fellow citizen will answer your call. A Brazilian consultant for a university in Brazil, applying the same logic everywhere we reach.

points.title: Nothing to translate, nothing to explain
points.body: You describe your situation exactly once and in the language you think in, to someone who already knows what a diploma from your country looks like and how your school's grading system works.

points.title: Universities take the meeting
points.body: An international office is far more willing to listen to someone who understands their market, their calendar and the actual financial capabilities of their students. All of this in their own language and without needing interpreters.

points.title: The cultural shorthand does the heavy lifting
points.body: Instantly understanding why a family hesitates or what kind of reassurance actually works for a parent is not something you learn from a manual. This natural sensitivity saves endless conversations.

match.honestNote: If we do not cover your country yet, we will tell you clearly from the very first call and pair you with the consultant whose experience best matches yours. We would rather be honest than make promises we cannot keep.

network.heading: A network, not a head office
network.body: We do not have a headquarters with a waiting room. Kimere is a tight-knit group of independent professionals. Everyone runs their own practice, lives in their own country and oversees a specific phase of your journey. This exact structure is what allows us to take you to whichever destination you choose, ensuring there is almost always someone awake and ready to answer when you write to us.

points.title: Independent professionals, not employees
points.body: Our team is made of experts with their own independent business. This keeps our structure light and ensures you are dealing with people who love their work, not just clerks assigned to your file.

points.title: Spread across several countries
points.body: Being scattered across the globe is the secret to our cultural alignment. It allows us to cover new destinations without having to open physical offices first, expanding our network one professional at a time.

points.title: One single coordinator, accountable for everything
points.body: A distributed network could easily turn into passing the buck. Not with us. You will have a single coordinator who will follow your journey from the first call to the final signature. They are the only person you will ever have to deal with.

team.heading: The people you will actually deal with
team.body: A deliberately small group. From the introductory call onwards you will have one trusted point of contact, and all the other figures involved will be just a message away. No cold and impersonal ticketing systems.

languages.heading: Courses in seven languages and in-house translators
languages.body: Our language teachers are a permanent part of the team, not just external suppliers. They teach the courses and directly translate your academic documents. This setup allows us to start a procedure the exact same day you ask for it, avoiding endless waiting times.
languages.languagesLabel: Languages we teach and work in

inHouse.title: Translation, on our side of the table
inHouse.body: We internally translate certificates and diplomas. Being already at work on your file, we know exactly what the receiving office wants to see and in what format they demand it.

inHouse.title: The legalization process, followed through
inHouse.body: We handle the Apostille or consular legalization based on the country that issued your qualification. We prepare and monitor the process with you, without brushing you off with a useless list of instructions.

inHouse.title: Courses built around a student's week
inHouse.body: We offer online lessons taught by native professionals with schedules specifically designed for students, not based on office hours. You start before you leave and continue without interruption once you arrive.

languages.limitHeading: What we cannot guarantee you (and nobody else can either)
languages.limitBody: No agency can erase legal requirements. The comparability statement for a foreign qualification is the exclusive responsibility of CIMEA or the university. Beware of anyone promising easy shortcuts, they are only selling you illusions. Our job is to compile a flawless file, translate the documents internally and follow it through so that bureaucracy never becomes an insurmountable obstacle.

connected.heading: You will hear from us more often than you expect
connected.body: We work with our clients with the exact same dynamism we apply internally. We organize frequent alignment calls and maintain fluid communication to keep you constantly updated on the process in real time. On long journeys like these, clarity is what truly makes the difference.

points.title: Alignment calls, not status reports
points.body: No boring formal reports. We organize short, regular calls directly with the person working on your case. You will always know what the next deadline is and exactly where we stand.

points.title: A fluid exchange inside the team
points.body: Your coordinator is constantly in touch with the specialist handling your file. We resolve every issue very quickly because we do not rely on any automated system.

points.title: You are involved, not managed
points.body: We empower you to make the important decisions that affect you directly. We build the plan step by step with you, never at your expense.

limits.heading: What we don't do
items: We do not issue visas or residence permits and we do not guarantee outcomes. Those decisions belong exclusively to the consulate and the Questura.
We are not affiliated with nor do we act on behalf of any university or public body, whether in Italy or anywhere else in the world.
We are not a real estate agency. We limit ourselves to viewing, verifying and registering real housing, but we do not collect deposits on behalf of third parties.
We do not replace the advice of a lawyer or an accountant. When a legal specialist is needed, we tell you transparently.
We began operating in June 2026 and our legal structure is being formalized. We will share all company documentation during the advanced stages instead of listing it here.

finalCta.heading: Want to know us better? Take the first step.
finalCta.body: We have two options depending on your profile. Neither of them has initial costs or commitments.
finalCta.studentLabel: I am a student, I want a consultation
finalCta.studentNote: You will fill out a short questionnaire, so we can research your profile before speaking with you directly.
finalCta.institutionLabel: I represent a university or agency, book the seminar
finalCta.institutionNote: A free session with absolutely no commitment, built exactly around the needs of your market.
